title: Funnier clip tags v1
description: clip.tags in clips.json. Granular, metadata-only tags for topic heats (3/4-way) and topic compilations. Every inferred value is a triple [value, confidence 0..1, source]. Source: rule (derived from other clip fields / channel lists), title (YouTube title), desc (YouTube description snippet, Shorts description/keywords), manual (human-reviewed; never overwritten by tools/tag-clips.py). No transcripts or bit text are ever stored. format, region, carrier and sec stay top-level clip fields (see TAGS.md).

topicId.description: Slash path into schema/topics.json (root/branch/leaf). Ancestors are implied, never stored.

topics.description: Most specific matching nodes, highest confidence first. title matches 0.8 (leaf) / 0.7 (inner node); desc matches 0.4.

premise.description: Short bit label in our own words (cleaned from the upload title; comic name, channel and special names removed). null when the title carries no bit (e.g. 'Stand Up - 2009', Kill Tony episode numbers).

style.description: Clip-level style evidence only. The comic-level persona prior (funnygraph) stays in the top-level clip.style.

year.description: Best estimate of the performance year. src desc = upload year (an upper bound), low confidence.

band.description: short <=75 s, mid <=180 s, long <=420 s, xl >420 s
